svg.title: Your callouts, all together. — Callout Studio
svg.desc: The My callout types settings page lists Idea, Meeting, and Research with two IDs each, with their actual color swatches and editing controls. Production components in phone layout with synthetic content on a purple promotional background, without a simulated Obsidian workspace. Mobile store artwork, 900 by 1600 pixels.
